textNotes.text: I've been covering Dragonwilds since day one, following every update, reveal, patch, and development milestone, so I'll also share insights and details that many new players may have missed.
Umbral Sands is and has been my most anticipated update for Dragon Wilds and I think there is going to be plenty of new and adjusted mechanics coming to the game when this update launches.

textNotes.author: @flame1148
textNotes.text: Just FYI, you missed a sanguine urn around 18:30.  Once youve made your way up the pipes and platforms, double jump from the top to the hanging lamp.  From there jump and dash to the right for another platform, then quickly jump and manuever to the right into a hidden upper level room with the urn.
